scope.textResizeMethod: Every rendered element receives twice its original computed font-size and line-height, without resizing images or layout dimensions. This is a text-only resize stress test, not browser-native zoom.
scope.touchMethod: Chromium CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent in a hasTouch mobile context; browser-dispatched multi-touch generates real pointer events. Close is verified with a real tap before gestures and Escape after gestures. This is emulation, not a physical-device pass.
scope.imageDecodeMethod: The expanded matrix makes real img elements eager and awaits decoding to verify source availability. It does not establish native lazy-loading trigger timing or performance; the separate smoke suite scrolls images into view naturally.

limitations: Automated checks supplement visual review and do not establish complete WCAG conformance.
Desktop browser engines and Chromium mobile touch emulation are tested; no physical device or OS screen reader is used.
External URL availability is reported separately and does not fail internal acceptance.

After the custom CDP multi-touch/pan stream, Chromium suppressed the next compatibility click even at 1200 ms. Post-pan touch Close is therefore not claimed; pre-gesture touch Close and post-gesture Escape are checked separately.

followUps.reason: Targeted link revalidation after corrections to actual internal hrefs and responsive image sizes. The 627 passing route/width/browser observations remain from the complete prior build/run; timestamps distinguish these revisions.
